title: Density of an integer multiplicity weight equals its multiplicity Hⁿ-a.e. (Simon Ch. 3, 1.5(3), 1.8; Ch. 1, 3.6–3.7) (with the upper density lemma, Simon Ch. 1, 3.6–3.7(2), proved inside)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be any set and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in V (IMRep V n: M ⊆ V Borel and countably n-rectifiable, θ : ℝ^P → ℕ Borel with θ ≥ 1 on M, ξ orienting the approximate tangent space of M at Hⁿ-a.e. point of M, Hⁿ = μHE[n]), with weight μ_R = θHⁿ⌞M (R.measure). Let W ⊆ ℝ^P be open and assume μ_R(K ∩ W) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P. Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P, μ_R(B_ρ(x) ∩ W)/(ω_nρⁿ) → 1_{M∩W}(x)·θ(x) in [0, ∞] as ρ ↓ 0, where B_ρ(x) is the open ball, ω_n = unitBallVolume n and the denominator is written unitBallVolume n · ofReal(ρⁿ) (division in [0, ∞]).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep V n), IsOpen W → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → R.measure (K ∩ W) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => R.measure (ball x ρ ∩ W) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (Set.indicator (R.carrier ∩ W) (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ≥0∞)) x))
